params.prompt: Medium close-up of one small round golden puppy with short floppy tan ears, a cream muzzle and belly, a small rounded brown nose and a single short tail resting still, sitting on the cream floor in a bright pastel playroom with a soft peach wall, mint furniture and a clean cream floor, soft even lighting. Match the puppy markings and proportions in the reference. Entire head, both ears, front paws and short tail visible. Puppy centered, uncluttered lower foreground. Only the puppy in frame. Clean single tail silhouette without motion streaks or floating marks, bright saturated 3D cartoon animation style, Pixar-like soft rounded shapes, clean simple background, one focal object per shot, eye-level or slightly low camera, soft even lighting, full-bleed edge-to-edge, no border, no frame, no vignette, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks

items.record: python3 momo/hf_jobs.py record --ep ep14 --cut c05 --kind image --job-id <JOB_ID> --url '<URL>' --status generated

notes: 이미지는 한 번에 3~4장씩만 병렬, 12장 이상 동시 요청 금지. 처음이면 1번 컷 1장 → 씬 1 의 3장 순서로 보여주고 승인받을 것
결과 확인 후: 같은 record 명령에 --status approved | rejected --reason "..." (job 이 같으면 크레딧 재계산 없음)
